about: Skills rebuild (docs/design/skills-v2.md §2.3-§2.7, §15): the fixed vocabulary every skill is written in, its costs and caps. tools/lint-skills.mjs validates data/skills/ against it; src/people/engine/skills2.js reads it. Costs are tuned by the balance harness, never by feel.
rankNote: D to SSS are the ranks of the owner's order 82; X stands above SSS for the skills of the few legends (no gods as beings, order 83).
rarityNote: A skill's rarity is a word of the one ladder (data/rarity.json, D-200: basic, rare, epic, legendary, mythical), read by tools/lib/skills2-check.mjs from there; its budget grows by rarityBonus. One holder at a time is the census 'one', apart from rarity; a legendary or mythical skill has census one or age (check 9).
kindsNote: The owner's three kinds (order 92, D-186): active (used on purpose in a fight, readied in a slot), passive (fires by itself when its condition holds) and buff (heals, or raises a stat for a while). An art of the three kinds acts only in its moment: an active or a buff by one `active` effect riding on a duel move (`base`), a passive by `trigger` effects; tools/lib/skills2-check.mjs check 11 holds the rest (E.kindFaults). A ladder's rung is a passive of the older sense (always on).

strike.note: a blow on top of the exchange won: a share of the user's fighting worth as damage; pierce (points of armour ignored) optional

heal.note: in a fight: a share of the full blood (hp) or of the wind spent (wind); in a month: v wounds healed, or a share of an illness's toll taken off

raise.note: a stat raised for the art's spec.duration (a fight's rounds, the fight, a month), then gone

guard.note: a share taken off every blow while it lasts

status.note: the foe's state on an exchange won: stun and knock in rounds, bleed a blow each round for three, slow, disarm and tire in points

kinds.note: The three kinds' moments (D-186): a share is worth this many points of budget a whole (40 x 0.05 = 2: a C rung's first level), times the cooldown's factor (E.coolFactor) for an active or a buff, the trigger's for a passive.

costNote: A perk effect that carries a release row (legacy) costs nothing: it continues the release's knack so A.perkSum is the same at the switch (§7); step 6 prices it as a real effect.

spec.note: Every skill carries spec (§15.6): cooldown { v, per }, cost [{ res, v }], effect { amount, unit } or { share }, duration { v, unit }, conditions (a list of needs objects). null means none or not yet specified; the first rungs leave them null. Skills have no range (the owner, 2026-11-25: they are used in combat or training); a rare skill may carry reach, a short note, where it truly matters. An active or trigger effect may carry its own spec.

caps.note: Stacking caps (§2.4), rising by the highest rank among the skills that give the bonus (§15.1). The adapter applies them, so no data can break them.
caps.kindsNote: The three kinds in a fight (D-186): one blow's share of the user's fighting worth, what one fight heals of the full blood, what a guard takes off a blow, a stat raised by buffs, the rounds a foe is held. The engine's CAP_HUMAN is the ceiling up to S.

shares.note: Rank shares in 100 (§2.7 check 9), held once the library has `from` skills or more (the first rungs alone are a ladder, not a library). SS, SSS and G come with magic and monsters.

starts.note: What a newborn of each start can reach without anyone's leave (§2.7 check 6): the routes open to him. evolve, merge and awaken are open to all once their sources are reached.
